noah: quick sync on attribution gaps after we aggressively compact spans. ran into a tenant who only stamps billing on DB child spans.
jamie: ouch. so pruning loses billing_key.
sarah: can we require a tiny root envelope that carries the essential keys? lightweight and stable.
alex: agree. name it joinpoint_v1. root only. children get a hash ref when needed to avoid PII.
noah: +hashed refs for older agents. ingest does a best-effort late lookup to resolve hashes.
jamie: need to bound lookups: cache + bloom filter + async resolver. otherwise it will crush ingest.
infra-bot: deploy: obsv-agent v0.22 canary started at 2025-06-20T11:00Z targeting 3% :rocket:
sarah: dashboard: pct traces with joinpoint / hashed_only / unresolved. make it visible for the rollout window.
alex: i'll prototype the cache and post perf numbers next week.
noah: action items: jamie draft brief RFC for joinpoint schema + fallback rules; alex materialize lookup perf; infra to add dashboard panels. thanks.
